name: agent-turn
title: Agent Turn
description: An agent's turn in a conversation: its reasoning and tool calls, and what it said in between, under one title ("Worked for 6m 12s") above its answer, its chevron after it and a rule under it when open. Each step is a line of what was done, not what was typed: an icon for its kind (a book for a read, a pencil for an edit, a terminal for a command), its verb and what it acted on a step lighter (files by their names, underlined with dots, the path on hover), what came of it at the end ("4 edits · +38 −12", an alert and "Exit 2" by weight, not red) and how long it took on hover. A call's kind (read, search, list, edit, write, command, or the app's own) and its data (command, description, path, pattern, added and removed lines, diff, output, exit code) are enough: describeCommand reads a shell command as a read ("Read composer.tsx", "Read 3 files"), a search, a listing or an edit (sed -i), else a short command as it is ("Ran pnpm build"), else the agent's own description, as it is, the same while it runs and once done, else "Ran a script"; a leading cd is left out. A run, the steps between two things it said, is one row a thing: a file's edits merged (opened, their hunks by the file's order with their new line numbers, the first lines and "Show all"), files written in a row on one row, reads, searches and listings in a row under one nested line ("Read 6 files, searched 3 times"); it folds under one line past three kinds keeping edits, commands and reads first, the rest counted ("Explored 6 files, edited 4, ran 4 commands and 6 other actions"), files once each, and at its end the failures nothing later made good (on a phone the number alone). A command opened shows itself whole, wrapped, to copy (and to open in the app's view with onExpand), and its output's last lines on the side's grey, the earlier ones on request, each line in its tone: what failed strong, the output muted, passes and the tally faint (agentOutputTone, or the app's outputTone). While it runs nothing opens or closes by itself: the live run is one line, saying the step a tool is at in place of its sum, each step's in turn as they come, as a GPT turn does (a spinner, shimmering; opened, its sum and the step under way under the list; a step waiting for the reader, with a progress line or media, or opened by the reader stands under it; a shield and "Wants to run …", "Waiting for you" while it waits for the reader); what the reader opened stays open and new steps join it; the turn folds once, when it ends, only if the reader never touched it, so the answer does not move. Folded, a failure nothing made good is still seen at its title's end ("1 failed", an alert before it). Stopped or failed, its title says so ("Stopped after 2m 03s") and its last row where ("Stopped while running Type-check the app"); stopped, what it had said is kept, dimmed, and under it its whole footer, its facts how it ended ("Stopped by you · 12:06"), so retry is a press away. While it runs and the app's link to the agent is lost, connection says so at its end, a status ("Reconnecting 2/5" shimmering, or "Disconnected"), in place of its spinner. While it runs, its title is in the text's colour, shimmering, as a running step's words are; while it thinks, it says so ("Thinking · 4s") over a running step's spinner and the thought's newest bold heading, else its newest paragraph's first sentence, with Markdown stripped, muted, so it is seen going; once over, a quiet line ("Thought for 12s"), with no title over it when it is all the work; while it only thinks, its title is bare, its chevron and rule shown in their places when a step comes. While it runs, its title counts the time since startedAt each second and shows the app's metrics ("Working · 47s · 38 tok/s"); between steps, when nothing else is seen going, its end has a spinner alone, in the place an AgentTurnFooter then takes. A subagent is a step whose details are its own AgentTurn, its steps listed as they came one level under its words, with no run's line over them (its words are that line) and no title of its own and what it handed back last (AgentTurnResult, cut to 6 lines over "Show all" where long). AgentTurnStep is a call's line alone, outside a turn. AgentTurnTarget with href is a link on its step's line, over the line's button, shimmering itself while the step runs (in WebKit, a link's own layer gets none of its words' shimmer); in a fold's line, a button, it is its words alone. All its words are labels, for other languages. The reader's choices are kept with use-fold. Under an ended turn, its footer: copy, retry with a menu of other ways, the app's actions and a menu of more on the left; the model, how long and when on the right, a fact saying more alone on hover (AgentTurnFact: the time's full date), the turn's numbers in a card when pressed, in groups under their labels; its menus' hints plain small text, retry's menu opened from the whole retry group. Its actions shown on hover for turns before the last, its facts always; a finger's size on a phone; an open run's list (or a run of reads alone, opened) scrolls past min(18rem, 50dvh), fading at its edges and growing by the steps the reader opened in it, with the live step outside it, and while it runs it opens at its newest steps and follows them as they come unless the reader scrolled up; a command's output says "Earlier output not shown" or "Later output not shown" where the source cut it (outputTruncated: "start" or "end"), "No output" when a finished command printed nothing and "Loading output…" while outputLoading, and shown whole it scrolls past 20rem and follows its end while it runs unless the reader scrolled up; steps and onLoadSteps let a turn's steps load when opened, with three skeleton lines or a message and Retry. Toggling a fold keeps its line in place on screen, except while the conversation follows its live end. What the reader decided (a decision's row) and what a step viewed or made (its `media`, e.g. thumbnails, shown under its line) stay in sight right after a folded run's line or the folded work's title, in order (side by side, each picture's card as wide as alone in the conversation, up to 6 of the 12 columns; a step's several pictures or a video a row of their own), and show once, in place, when opened; a step still under way does too under an ended turn's folded work. What came from outside (an event part, an AgentEvent: a monitor's line, a background task's end, a wake-up) stays where it came, never folded into a run, one after the last step with the answer. What the user sent while it ran (a steer part) stays where it came, at its end edge as the user's message (UserMessageText's bubble and 16px text, cut to 6 lines over "Show all" where long), always seen, and the work before and after it each fold under a title as a turn's work, with its own time ("Worked for 40s"; the last "Working" while it runs, counted from its steer), steers back to back splitting it once; an attempt cut off and replaced (a superseded part) is one closed line ("Superseded attempt · Cut off by a steer") that opens to its parts, loaded when opened if they are not there yet. While a ConversationFind is open, each closed fold (work, run, step, superseded attempt, a command's earlier output lines) holds its text, read from the parts' data, hidden until found (FoldFindText); found, it opens as if the reader had opened it, its content not mounted until then.
